rationale: Conceptually appropriate and conditionally supported for an exploratory de‑risking experiment package. Critical gaps must be addressed up front (large‑animal/IN delivery and in vivo detection limits, assay sensitivity in low‑biomass lavage/CSF, orthogonal spike‑in validation, detergent/protease artifact controls, and reproducible bounded EV fraction manufacturability across lots) with predefined go/no‑go criteria.
